facts.text: NASA-STD-7009B, dated 5 March 2024, establishes modeling and simulation practice around credibility, verification, validation, sensitivity and uncertainty.

facts.text: NASA-STD-7009B states that acceptance criteria are to be defined by the program and approved by technical authority.

facts.text: ASME's VVUQ guidance distinguishes verification, which checks whether the implementation matches the mathematics, from validation, which checks whether the model represents the real application, and from uncertainty quantification.
facts.quote: ASME's VVUQ guidance distinguishes verification (does the implementation match the mathematics), validation (does it represent the real application) and uncertainty quantification [5].

facts.text: To address simulator credibility objections, the simulation specialist recommends voluntarily adopting one of the cited credibility frameworks and running a credibility pilot before committing to the plan.

facts.text: In an SAE paper dated 27 September 2016, Salaani and colleagues built hardware-in-the-loop AEB simulation around an instrumented Volvo tractor-trailer with a Bendix radar and AEB system.

facts.text: The documented heavy-vehicle AEB virtualization example retained physical referents and made later testing more efficient only after a credible comparison existed.

facts.text: A large virtual campaign can produce consistent but misleading results if the virtual sensor, collision logic and test oracle share the system under test's simplifying assumptions.

facts.text: No documented off-road collision-system case of common-mode error producing misleading virtual results was found; the risk is an inference from standard verification and validation practice.

facts.text: Standard verification and validation practice requires comparison against real-world referents rather than internal consistency alone.

facts.text: A validated simulator is not automatically valid across all machine dimensions, sensor positions, brake systems, loads, terrains and operating modes; credibility is tied to an intended-use envelope.

facts.text: The program must prove that machine variants can be handled by validated parameters rather than becoming separate simulation-development projects.
